_doc: Index of atlas folders. Written by the assembly script (see README_PAIRING.md §10). The browser cannot list directories, so this file is the authoritative answer to 'what atlases are installed?'. atlas_discovery.js reads this at startup.
_notes_2026_05_23: Added 'cross-species' atlas as Phase 1a of the 4-atlas split per docs/MIGRATION_4_ATLASES.md. Phase 1b (move existing comparative + mgl_* + cross-species shared modules from inversion-atlas) is the next step.
